records.title: Life cycle management — Part 1

records.title: Life cycle processes — Requirements engineering

records.title: An analysis of the requirements traceability problem
records.author: Orlena Gotel and Anthony Finkelstein
relevant_sections: repository abstract; downloadable paper not section-verified in this run

records.title: Business Process Model and Notation, Version 2.0.2
records.paraphrase: The specification defines process, collaboration, choreography, activity, event, gateway, data, and execution semantics, with explicit conformance classes.

records.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
records.paraphrase: PROV-O models entities, activities, agents, use, generation, derivation, attribution, revision, invalidation, roles, plans, and qualified influence.

records.title: The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
records.author: Mark D. Wilkinson et al.
records.paraphrase: The principles require persistent identifiers, rich metadata, explicit identifier links, detailed provenance, and community standards.

records.title: A Tradecraft Primer: Structured Analytic Techniques for Improving Intelligence Analysis

records.paraphrase: The manual instructs analysts to define observable indicators and review them over time, and to compare alternatives using evidence that can disconfirm them.
